title: Graduation Thesis (Logistics and Supply Chain Management)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop a theoretical framework based on deep knowledge of logistics and supply chain management for the graduation thesis.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Supplementing Theoretical Framework with Knowledge from Other Courses
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Utilize knowledge from other courses to enhance the theoretical framework for the graduation thesis.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Drafting, Reviewing, and Presenting Graduation Thesis Content
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Prepare, present, and deliver the content of the graduation thesis.
Describe the current research issues and assess them according to the theoretical framework.
Evaluate the impact of the business environment on research issues and identify directions for addressing these issues.
Be able to independently complete the graduation thesis.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Logical Structure and Consistency of Thesis Content
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ensure the graduation thesis has a logical structure and consistent content.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Objective Evaluation Based on Clear Evidence
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Provide objective evaluations based on clear evidence.
